# `/segments` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### POST /segments/v1

`createSegmentV1` — Create segment

This API creates a segment. >**Note:** Segment definitions may take time to propagate to all identities.

- Scopes: idn:segment:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): segment
- Returns 201: segment

### GET /segments/v1

`listSegmentsV1` — List segments

This API returns a list of all segments.

- Scopes: idn:segment:manage, idn:segment:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
- Returns 200: array of segment

### GET /segments/v1/{id}

`getSegmentV1` — Get segment by id

This API returns the segment specified by the given ID.

- Scopes: idn:segment:manage, idn:segment:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The segment ID to retrieve.
- Returns 200: segment

### DELETE /segments/v1/{id}

`deleteSegmentV1` — Delete segment by id

This API deletes the segment specified by the given ID. >**Note:** that segment deletion may take some time to become effective.

- Scopes: idn:segment:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The segment ID to delete.
- Returns 204: no body

### PATCH /segments/v1/{id}

`patchSegmentV1` — Update segment

Use this API to update segment fields by using the [JSON Patch](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6902) standard. >**Note:** Changes to a segment may take some time to propagate to all identities.

- Scopes: idn:segment:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The segment ID to modify.
- Body (application/json-patch+json): array of object
- Returns 200: segment
